Still, staying near populated hubs reduces kill exposure. Given the uncertainty, I'll move to Medbay to gather information and keep watching for Impostor movement through vents.

text: MOVE from Upper Engine to Security
thought: All five of my assigned tasks are marked completed, so my personal contribution is finished. The available actions don't include reporting or calling a meeting, so I can only move. Since the Impostor could be any of the other players, staying useful means watching for suspicious movement. Upper Engine connects to Reactor, Lower Engine, Cafeteria, Security, and Medbay. Security has cameras that could reveal what others are doing, which is the most valuable information source for spotting Impostors. Moving to Security gives me surveillance coverage, and it's also a room where I can observe any venting or kills in progress. White was last seen heading to Cafeteria, so going to Security is a good way to gather info without following into a potentially dangerous area alone.

Admin is currently empty except for me, so there is no target here. Moving to Cafeteria is a reasonable choice: it is a central room with an emergency button, and it lets me check for isolated Crewmates while keeping a believable task-like route. Its vent to Admin also gives me a quick escape path back here after any future kill. O2 is a dead-end room with little traffic, which could be useful later but offers less mobility. Storage and Electrical have already been visited recently, so returning there would look like wandering. Cafeteria is the best option to find a lone Crewmate and keep my movement plausible.

My tasks are done, so I can't contribute further task progress; my value now is observation and helping locate Impostors. Available moves from O2 are Weapons, Shields, and Admin. Weapons is a vent-connected room (vent to Navigation), which is a potential Impostor escape point, so checking it gives observation of vent activity. Shields is a hub that connects to many rooms and I was there recently, so it's a lower-value revisit. Admin is a vent point to Cafeteria and I was there earlier; it's also reasonable for watching the Admin–Cafeteria vent. Weapons has been unobserved for a while and sits on the Navigation vent, where cyan was recently active, so moving there gives the most fresh information and watches a vent route cyan could be using.

The task list marks Accept Diverted Power (Navigation) as completed, and it appears my previous action just completed it. The only remaining incomplete task is Empty Chute at Storage, reachable via Navigation->Shields->Storage. The available actions are to move to Shields or Weapons; Shields is on the path to Storage, so moving to Shields is the correct step toward finishing my last task. No evidence of an Impostor has been observed, so there is no reason to call a meeting or deviate.

Since all my tasks are done, my value lies in information gathering and survival. The only available actions are moving to Cafeteria or Upper Engine. Impostors can vent, and Medbay connects by vent to Electrical and Security, but I cannot use vents as a Crewmate, so I have no vent option here. Cafeteria is a populated hub with an emergency button and a vent to Admin, which makes it a reasonable place to watch traffic. Upper Engine is where Red was recently seen doing a task, and it has a vent to Reactor, which could be a risk. Staying near busy areas reduces kill exposure, and Cafeteria gives access to more rooms for observation. I'll move to Cafeteria.

My personal tasks are done, so my remaining value is as an observer who helps identify Impostors. VIEW MONITOR is available only here in Security and gives camera coverage of the ship, which is the best way to gather information on other players' movements, potential venting, or kills. Viewing the monitor now costs nothing in terms of task progress and maximizes information about where white and black are and whether anyone is acting suspiciously. Moving elsewhere right now would leave the camera room without coverage and would not add information. I will use VIEW MONITOR.

Killing Player 1 now would happen in front of nobody else, since only the two of us are in Cafeteria, so a kill here would be unreported at the time of the act. However, the kill is an available option, and the room has two players only, so it's a safe window. Still, killing immediately after Player 1 arrives could look suspicious if they later report a body near me, and the Cafeteria is a high-traffic room with an emergency button, so others may arrive soon. Killing now gives a quick elimination with a clean opportunity; leaving it means risking a third player entering and witnessing. Since the Impostor win condition depends on eliminating Crewmates early, taking the isolated opportunity is strategically sound. Moving away would waste a window where Player 1 is alone with me. I will take the kill.

Weapons is a vent-connected room (vent to Navigation), so it is a possible Impostor escape point, and I have not observed it recently. Since I have no tasks left, my best contribution is to keep moving through rooms and watch for sightings. The options are Navigation (where cyan was last seen and has a vent link to Shields and Weapons), Cafeteria (vent to Admin and the emergency button, central hub), or O2 (where I just came from). Navigation has the most fresh information value because cyan was last active there and it sits on a vent route; checking it could reveal whether cyan is following vent paths. Cafeteria is also a useful hub, but Navigation directly tests the cyan suspicion. I'll move to Navigation.

My last remaining task is Empty Chute in Storage, and Storage is directly adjacent to Shields. Moving toward Storage is the most efficient path to finish my tasks and help the crew win. Black and yellow have both been in or passing through Storage, but there's no evidence of an Impostor, so there's no reason to avoid it. Moving to Storage keeps me on track; I should stay alert for any suspicious activity while doing so.

My tasks are done, so my value now is information. Security's camera monitor is the only way to see multiple rooms at once, which helps me spot venting, kills, or suspicious movement. Viewing the monitor again costs no task progress and refreshes what I know about where white and black are. Moving to another room would take me away from the cameras without adding coverage, so staying and viewing is the best choice for finding Impostors and keeping the crew informed.

The body is in Cafeteria, where I am standing. Reporting it myself would call a meeting now, and as the only one present I would be the obvious suspect since I was alone with the victim. Staying in Cafeteria and waiting risks others arriving and reporting the body while I am still here. Moving away to a different room lets me appear to be doing tasks elsewhere, and if someone else finds the body, I can claim I was elsewhere. Weapons is adjacent and Player 2 was recently around there, so moving there could place me near another crewmate and build an alibi through a witness, while Upper Engine and Medbay are far from the others. The safest choice is to leave Cafeteria, establish a presence in a different area, and avoid reporting the body myself so I am not the one calling the meeting.

I have no tasks left, so I should move through rooms to gather information. My available moves are Shields or Weapons. Weapons was where I just was and I saw nobody there. Shields is a vent-connected room (to Navigation) and sits between my position and several others, and black was last seen leaving Shields, so visiting Shields lets me check on the area black and cyan passed through and whether anyone is using the vent route near Navigation. Moving to Shields gives more fresh observation value than revisiting Weapons, which I just checked.

I am already in Storage, the location of my final task, Empty Chute. Completing it now is the most efficient action: it finishes my assignments and moves the crew closer to winning. Leaving or wandering would only waste time and expose me to risk without benefit. Black and yellow have been in or near Storage, but no evidence points to either being an Impostor, so there is no reason to flee. After completing the task I will stay alert for anything suspicious and be ready to report or call a meeting if needed.
